units.source_scale_reason: Reviewed source-resolution registration; one anatomical scale per original image.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. The first idle juggled, danced and threw instead of idling; a calm retake went dark, and a fresh-seed copy of it is used. Attack and ranged were retaken with steady light because the first takes went dark and the first attack burst into a spore cloud. The ranged throw drops the frames where the orb is shown in flight. The defend keeps every frame of its quick duck into the crouch. The walk loops video 43-104 every second frame. Walk, hit, defend, cast and death are first takes.
